title: "Pixel Rulers"
format: html

## Overview

The Media Viewer can show pixel rulers along the top and left edges of the canvas, similar to Inkscape. Ruler labels show coordinates in **source image pixels** (matching annotation coordinates).

## Toggling Rulers

Open the Media Viewer properties panel and expand the **Rulers** section. Use **Show rulers** to enable or disable the ruler bars.

## Tick Options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| **Tick mode** | *Auto* chooses readable intervals based on zoom; *Fixed interval* uses a constant spacing in pixels |
| **Fixed interval** | Spacing between ticks when using fixed mode (e.g. every 50 px) |
| **Target ticks** | Approximate number of major ticks when using auto mode |
| **Show minor ticks** | Display smaller ticks between major labels |
| **Negative color** | Color for tick labels when coordinates are negative (e.g. after panning past the origin) |

Rulers update automatically when you zoom with the mouse wheel or pan with Shift+drag.
